copy.heroHeadline: Austin plumbers who show up and fix it right
copy.heroSubheadline: From clogged drains to burst pipes, our licensed team gets your water flowing again without the runaround.
copy.about: Reliable Rooter is a family plumbing company. We explain the problem, give you a clear price before any work starts, and clean up after ourselves. Most of our work comes from neighbors who told their neighbors.

sectionIntros.services: Repairs and installs for homes across the Austin area.
sectionIntros.contact: Tell us what is going on and we will call you back.

serviceDescriptions.description: We clear kitchen, bath and main line clogs and tell you what caused them.
Tank and tankless water heaters repaired or replaced, old unit hauled away.
Electronic leak detection finds hidden leaks before they ruin floors and walls.
Camera inspection first, then the least disruptive repair for your yard.
Faucets, toilets, disposals and showers installed properly the first time.

faq.question: Do you charge for estimates?
faq.answer: No. We give you a clear written price before any work starts, and there is no charge if you decide not to go ahead.

faq.question: Can you come out for an emergency?
faq.answer: Yes. Call us any time, day or night, and a plumber will call you back right away to help you shut off the water and get someone out.

faq.question: Do you clean up after the job?
faq.answer: Always. We use floor covers, take away old parts and leave your home the way we found it.

faq.question: Which areas do you cover?
faq.answer: Austin and the surrounding towns listed below. If you are just outside that area, call and ask.
